ruleDefinitions.name: Malicious PowerShell Keywords
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects keywords from well-known PowerShell exploitation frameworks Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*AdjustTokenPrivileges.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*IMAGE\\_NT\\_OPTIONAL\\_HDR64\\_MAGIC.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Metasploit.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Microsoft\\\.Win32\\\.UnsafeNativeMethods.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Mimikatz.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*MiniDumpWriteDump.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*PAGE\\_EXECUTE\\_READ.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ReadProcessMemory\\\.Invoke.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*SE\\_PRIVILEGE\\_ENABLED.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*SECURITY\\_DELEGATION.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*TOKEN\\_ADJUST\\_PRIVILEGES.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*TOKEN\\_ALL\\_ACCESS.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*TOKEN\\_ASSIGN\\_PRIMARY.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*TOKEN\\_DUPLICATE.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*TOKEN\\_ELEVATION.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*TOKEN\\_IMPERSONATE.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*TOKEN\\_INFORMATION\\_CLASS.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*TOKEN\\_PRIVILEGES.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*TOKEN\\_QUERY.*"))
